steps.en: A daily job prepares the 2nd reminder letter run
steps.id: Job harian menyiapkan proses surat reminder ke-2
steps.why_en: Daily letter run is switched off in code; letters only go out when triggered by hand
steps.why_id: Job surat harian dimatikan di code; surat hanya keluar kalau dipicu manual

steps.en: Due, unsuspended NOPOs at the 2nd reminder stage are picked
steps.id: NOPO yang jatuh tempo dan tidak disuspend di tahap reminder ke-2 dipilih

steps.en: The letter goes to the hirer's latest address; no address means skipped
steps.id: Surat ke alamat terbaru hirer; tanpa alamat dilewati

steps.en: OCMS builds a data file with the letter details for printing
steps.id: OCMS membuat file data berisi detail surat untuk dicetak

steps.en: The file is stored and encrypted for sending
steps.id: File disimpan dan dienkripsi untuk dikirim

steps.en: The file is delivered to the print vendor
steps.why_en: Delivery to the vendor is blocked by configuration in every environment, so the file does not leave the system.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor diblok lewat konfigurasi di semua environment, jadi file tidak keluar dari sistem.

steps.en: After sending, the NOPO moves on and is marked as sent
steps.id: Setelah dikirim, NOPO maju ke tahap berikutnya dan ditandai terkirim
steps.why_en: While sending is blocked the NOPO still moves on and is marked as sent, though no letter left.
steps.why_id: Saat pengiriman diblok, NOPO tetap maju dan ditandai terkirim padahal tidak ada surat keluar.
